title: Unmapped Tape Head Remains Fixed
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota:\mathrm{Fin}(m)\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Fin}(k)$ be an embedding, and choose a tape index $\mathrm{cap}$ outside its image. Let $M$ be an $m$-work-tape machine, and let $\mathrm{tapes}$ and $\mathrm{heads}$ specify the contents and head positions of the $k$ tapes; let $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{out}_0$ be words and $c$ an initial configuration of $M$. For any time $t$ and tape index $j$ outside the image of $\iota$ with $j\ne\mathrm{cap}$, the head of tape $j$ in the embedded computation visits exactly the singleton $\{\mathrm{heads}(j)\}$ through time $t$, and that tape uses exactly one cell.
